chunks: Muhammad ibn Umar ibn Muhammad ibn Salama ibn al-Bara al-Hafiz al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad ibn Ubaydullah al-Thaqafi Abu al-Abbas narrated to us. He said: Isa ibn Muhammad al-Katib narrated to us. He said: al-Madaini narrated to me, from Ghiyath ibn Ibrahim, from al-Sadiq Jafar ibn Muhammad, from his father, from his grandfather (peace be upon them). He said: Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said:
The minds of women are in their beauty, and the beauty of men is in their minds.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say about the minds of women and the beauty of men?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (AS) made an observation about the nature of men and women, stating that what defines intelligence for women is expressed through their beauty, while what defines beauty for men is expressed through their intellect. This was a well-known aphorism in the Arab literary tradition, recorded through a chain reaching Imam al-Sadiq (AS) at a scholarly gathering in 368 AH. The saying highlights complementary qualities valued in each gender in classical Islamic society.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. `Umar b. Muhammad b. Salama b. al-Bara’ al-Hafith al-Baghdadi narrated to us. He said: Ahmad b. `Ubaydullah al-Thaqafi Abu’l `Abbas narrated to us. He said: `Isa b. Muhammad al-Katib narrated to us. He said: al-Mada’ini narrated to me from Ghiyath b. Ibrahim from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his grandfather (as).  He said: `Ali b. Abi Talib (as) said:
The mind of women is in their beauty, and the beauty of men is in their mind.
